text:
Maya Singh: Quick note — ran the link scanner on the KB and it flagged a 404 in the 'kv-cache tuning' guide. The example S3 link points to s3://redwood-docs/old/kvcache/sample.json and returns 404 in staging and prod.
DocsBot: LinkScan complete — 1 critical, 2 warnings. ID: LS-2026-045. Affected file: /kb/infra/kv-cache-tuning.md
Maya Singh: Can someone own rehost + PR? Would be great to land before EOD so the runtime patch can ship with the doc fix.
Jared Kim: I can take this. Where should I rehost the example JSON?
Priya Patel: Rehost to s3://redwood-docs/stable/kv-cache-examples/ and update the markdown to the canonical CDN path: https://docs-cdn.redwood.io/kv-cache-examples/sample.json. @Luca Romano can you confirm the bucket write perms for the infra team?
Luca Romano: I can grant PUT for the team bucket. Jared — upload with this aws cli command:
```bash
aws s3 cp sample.json s3://redwood-docs/stable/kv-cache-examples/sample.json --acl bucket-owner-full-control --profile infra-deploy
```
Jared Kim: Uploading now, will open a tiny PR to update the markdown link and run the docs preview.
Jared Kim: PR opened: #4821 — updates the link and bumps frontmatter snapshot. @Priya Patel can you PTAL for a quick QA pass?
Priya Patel: Quick nit: use the canonical CDN host (docs-cdn.redwood.ai) instead of .io — run this sed before you commit:
```bash
sed -i 's|docs-cdn.redwood.io|docs-cdn.redwood.ai|g' kb/infra/kv-cache-tuning.md
```
Priya Patel: LGTM after that change — please merge when CI passes. :thumbsup:
DocsBot: Deploy preview ready: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/preview/4821 — preview shows no 404 on the example JSON.
Jared Kim: Merged and deployed to staging at 1745559120. Reassigned doc stewardship for /kb/infra/kv-cache-tuning.md from Maya -> Jared for the remainder of this sprint.
Maya Singh: Thanks all — @Luca thanks for the perms bump. I'll mark LS-2026-045 resolved on my side.
